# Embassy v1.9.4 — the upgrade path digs itself out

The first real machine to walk the v2→v3 upgrade path got stranded: its state carried the legacy default host identity, the new loader correctly refused it, and no command could recover it. Now the converter reconciles host identity in place — rerun `embassy convert-state-v2-to-v3` and it drops only untouched config-declared lazy routes behind a byte-verified backup, preserves every accumulated message and consent edge, and refuses (bytes unchanged) if anything real would be lost. Peer handshakes also stopped lying: a broker that refuses peer service says so explicitly at `initialize`, instead of claiming to be unavailable at the first catalog.

Upgrade: `npm install -g agent-embassy@1.9.4`, restart your brokers.
